name: 灵魂汲取
description: 对生命值最低的敌方棋子造成999点真实伤害，然后对所有存活的敌方棋子造成等同于该目标最大生命值30%的法术伤害。
targetText: 生命值最低的敌方棋子
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var enemies = battle.pieces.filter(function(p) { return !arePlayersAllied(battle, p.ownerPlayerId, caster.ownerPlayerId) && p.currentHp > 0; }); if (enemies.length === 0) return { success: false, message: '没有存活的敌方棋子' }; var weakest = enemies.reduce(function(min, p) { return p.currentHp < min.currentHp ? p : min; }); var savedMaxHp = weakest.maxHp; var splashDamage = Math.max(1, Math.floor(savedMaxHp * 0.3)); dealDamage(caster, weakest, 999, 'true', battle, 'kiljaedan-soul-drain'); var msg = caster.name + '对以下目标使用了灵魂汲取：' + weakest.name + '（以其maxHp=' + savedMaxHp + 'x30%=' + splashDamage + '）'; var remaining = battle.pieces.filter(function(p) { return !arePlayersAllied(battle, p.ownerPlayerId, caster.ownerPlayerId) && p.currentHp > 0; }); if (remaining.length > 0) { dealDamage(caster, remaining, splashDamage, 'magical', battle, 'kiljaedan-soul-drain'); msg += '，随后对' + remaining.length + '个存活敌方棋子各造成' + splashDamage + '点法术伤害'; } else { msg += '（没有存活敌人）'; } return { success: true, message: msg }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: '对生命值最低的敌方棋子造成999点真实伤害，然后对所有存活的敌方棋子造成等同于该目标最大生命值30%的法术伤害。', expectedValues: {} }; }
